fact: Semaglutide and tirzepatide are highly potent incretin receptor agonists that have marked a new era in the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity.
fact_zh: 司美格鲁肽和替尔泊肽是强效的肠促胰素受体激动剂，标志着2型糖尿病和肥胖治疗的新时代。
quote: The introduction of the highly potent incretin receptor agonists semaglutide and tirzepatide has marked a new era in the treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity.

fact: Therapeutic goals such as normalisation of glycated haemoglobin levels and weight losses around 15-25% are now within reach.
fact_zh: 治疗目标如糖化血红蛋白水平的正常化和约15-25%的体重减轻现在已变得可行。
quote: With normalisation of glycated haemoglobin levels and weight losses around 15-25%, therapeutic goals that were previously unrealistic are now within reach

fact: Clinical trials have documented that the effects of semaglutide and tirzepatide are associated with reduced risk of cardiovascular events and premature mortality.
fact_zh: 临床试验表明，司美格鲁肽和替尔泊肽的效果与心血管事件和早逝风险降低相关。
quote: clinical trials have documented that these effects are associated with reduced risk of cardiovascular events and premature mortality

fact: The review discusses the development from early observations of glucose lowering and modest weight losses with native GLP-1 and short acting compounds to recent highly active formulations and new molecules.
fact_zh: 该综述讨论了从早期观察到天然GLP-1和短效化合物的降糖和适度体重减轻，到近期高效配方和新分子的发展。
quote: from the earliest observations of glucose lowering and modest weight losses with native glucagon-like peptide (GLP)-1 and short acting compounds, to the recent development of highly active formulations and new molecules

fact: These agents are classified as GLP-1-based therapies, even though they may have actions on other receptors as well.
fact_zh: 这些药物被归类为基于GLP-1的疗法，尽管它们可能还作用于其他受体。
quote: I will classify these agents as GLP-1-based therapies in the understanding that these compounds or combinations may have actions on other receptors as well.
